review_trigger: Confidence below 0.999 or non-singleton APS set in the core view
operational_interpretation: Core reconstruction is almost deterministic; the review queue is tiny and mainly serves as a sanity check for rare residual errors.

review_trigger: Confidence below 0.999 under the proxy-restricted transport/volume view
operational_interpretation: Proxy restriction produces a practical uncertainty queue: the model rejects about one tenth of records while capturing most errors.

review_trigger: Confidence below 0.999 in the time-ordered stress split
operational_interpretation: The short temporal split remains near-deterministic, so the queue is mainly a chronological stability check.

review_trigger: Unseen application/category context, empty conformal set, or low confidence
operational_interpretation: This is the strongest operational boundary: high confidence is not sufficient, so unfamiliar application/category contexts should be reviewed explicitly.

review_trigger: Unseen destination-service context, empty conformal set, or low confidence
operational_interpretation: Destination-service shift leaves a smaller but still visible review queue and minority-class risk.

review_trigger: Held-out rule context, empty conformal set, or low confidence
operational_interpretation: Rule-context stress exposes policy-proximal pockets, especially high-confidence Drop-to-Allow residual errors.
